name: Master Salter Ondra
title: Mistress of the Pans
examine: Hands cured hard as oak, eyes pale from twenty years of white glare. She harvests weather.
lines: The sun does the work. I just keep the books between it and the mere.
A pan is a field. Flood it, dry it, rake it, rest it. Farmers understand me. Nobody else does.
Walk the lips, not the beds. The beds are money.
